newsitem.title: JAPAN: GLOBEX S&P 500 Sept futures rebound in Tokyo.
newsitem.headline: GLOBEX S&P 500 Sept futures rebound in Tokyo.

text.p: S&P September futures traded on the GLOBEX electronic trading system rebounded on Tuesday morning in Tokyo, after the Dow industrials plunged overnight, marking the second-largest single-day point drop ever.
As of 0222 GMT, September futures were 4.15 points higher at 885.90.
"Judging from the way the September futures contract is bouncing back, it seems that the dust is settling after the sharp fall on Wall Street on Monday," a dealer at a second-tier brokerage said.
